description: List what the organization has: every website, app, agent, and skill, with its kind, URL, access mode, and when it was last published. It is the first read when the user names something and you do not know what it is, and the way to recover a name an earlier publish has scrolled out of the conversation. Pass kind to narrow to one kind. Each row says its access mode. Valet's built-in skills are not listed until the organization makes its own; list_skills lists those. Requires connecting a Valet account.

kind.description: Narrow the list to one kind. Omit for everything.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to list. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_services
title: List websites, apps, agents, and skills
